description: A refined corporate conference room finished entirely in light oak wood paneling — full-height wall panels, built-in shelving alcoves, and matching conference table all share the same pale blonde grain, creating a seamless, monochromatic warmth. The large rectangular conference table seats twelve in cream-upholstered task chairs with brushed nickel sled bases. The table surface is light and near-white, with a desk phone and a single notepad visible. The accent wall behind features a white glass marker board mounted flush to the paneling, flanked symmetrically by open shelf niches holding ceramic vases, stacked books, and a small potted green plant. A larger potted green plant sits on the table surface near the far end, adding a living element. To the right, full-height windows are dressed with sheer white layered curtains, flooding the space with cool diffused daylight from outside. A grey-toned commercial carpet tiles the floor. A horizontal bar of warm directional light runs the length of the table from above — a clean, even wash of illumination that makes the pale wood surfaces glow. Camera at standing eye-level, one-point perspective looking straight down the length of the table, normal-to-wide lens, level pitch.
